title: Darwin dance-strut + twist — The Amazing World of Gumball, 'The Words' (GB214), Sc057 (wide) + Sc059 (close-up)
units: XFL twips/20 = pixels at authoring scale; matrices are Flash affine (a,b,c,d,tx,ty) with tx,ty in twips/20 as stored (XFL stores tx/ty in twips; values here are raw XML attribute values)

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) parsed via sequential local-header reader (these 2012 Flash zips have a malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Keyframes are pose-to-pose (keyMode 9728); sampled_frames expand by holding each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

beat.note: Sc059 Darwin puppet contains a 'beat' layer: keyframe spans [0-9,9-23,23-37,37-51,51-65,65-79,79-93,93-103,103-113] — a regular ~14-frame beat at 25fps (~107 BPM). Sc057 Masami puppet has a 'BEAT' layer (21 keyframes). Arms/legs/twist layers are keyframed every 2 frames (on twos) through the dance.

notes: Sc057 is the wide shot: Darwin dance-struts down the school hallway toward camera for the full 198 frames (7.9s), full body in frame; classmates (Tobias, Carmen, Masami, Ocho, Carrie, Tina) watch from the sides on BEAT layers.

Sc059 is the companion close-up of the same sequence: Darwin (waist-up, frame right) performs the beat-timed twist — its puppet timeline contains the layers literally named 'twist' (32 keyframes, active frames 43-97) and 'beat'.

In Sc057's SWF export some classmates (Tina, Carrie, Masami) render as line art — their colour pass is not in this V036 file; Darwin, Carmen and Tobias render in full colour. Choreography data is unaffected (transforms live in the FLA).
Matrices with negative 'a' are horizontal flips (the animators flipped the puppet in-scene). Pivots (transformationPoint) are included per element where the file stores them.
Part poses are (libraryItemName + firstFrame + matrix): a consumer rig maps its own parts onto the same slots (head comp, L/R fin, L/R leg, body) and plays the same firstFrame/matrix sequence.
